description: Given broad, possibly-ambiguous attributes about a person, return up to 20 strongly-related profiles ranked by match score. Sits between enrich (1:1) and search (open-ended) — ideal when you can't uniquely resolve someone. API: GET /person/identify.

company.description: Company name, website, or PDL company id the person works at.

email.description: Email address, or an array of email addresses.

location.description: Free-text location, e.g. 'San Francisco, CA, USA'.

pdl_id.description: PDL persistent ID for a person record.

postal_code.description: Postal / ZIP code (assumed US if no country).

profile.description: Social profile URL(s), e.g. a LinkedIn URL. String or array.

school.description: School name or website the person attended.

titlecase.description: Titlecase the returned data (default false = lowercase).

name: pdl_person_identify
title: Identify a person
